title: OnlyIdeas
shortDescription: Read research papers and explore ideas with a personal paper agent.
fullDescription:
A good idea often starts with a question in the margin. OnlyIdeas gives research papers a comfortable place to be read, questioned and discussed.

READ ON YOUR PHONE
Turn a PDF into flowing text with equations, tables and figures. Adjust the reading size, save papers for offline reading, and keep your place. Import your own PDF, Markdown or Mathpix Markdown, or add an open-access PDF by link.

FOLLOW A QUESTION
Talk to the paper agent in a native chat interface. Find open research, inspect a paper's abstract, then choose Convert & add to bring it into your private library. Return to your conversation history and continue exploring.

KEEP THE SOURCE CLOSE
Request a reading guide or translation when you need one. AI output is labeled and kept separate from the original paper so you can check it against the source.

READ AND DISCUSS TOGETHER
Discuss papers and selected passages. Private uploads stay private unless you explicitly request publication and the contribution is approved. Public contributions are moderated, with reporting and reader-blocking controls.

YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR CHOICES
Read public samples without an account. Sign in with GitHub to import papers, use the agent and join discussions. Delete your account from Profile. Conversion and AI requests run only when requested and use a shared allowance; availability and limits are shown in the app. Only upload documents you have permission to process.
